market.what: siloxane removal systems for landfill, sewage and digester gas (units + media), world
market.method: report: ~17,400 units x ~$24k = $410M (2025). Media cross-check (est.): ~26 bcm/yr siloxane-bearing raw gas x $2.5-11 per 1,000 m3 = $65-285M

value.logic: Media: carbon is the main opex; a sorbent with 2x capacity and no D5/TMS slip halves ~$150M media spend = $75M. Engines: dirty gas cuts overhaul interval 18k->7k h; est. 8 GW LFG/sewage engines x $14k/MW-yr avoided = ~$115M (est.)
value.revenue_logic: ~10% of est. $150M media spend at maturity, sold via system integrators
value.margin_logic: specialty sorbent priced vs activated carbon at $2-4/kg; must win on $/1,000 m3

trend.drivers: biogas +30% 2024-30 (IEA); RNG grid-injection specs; US biomethane to double by 2030; REPowerEU biomethane push

competition.notes: No funded startup found; field is carbon vendors + skid makers. Carbon lets D5 and TMS slip through. Tansel study: for small sites carbon adsorption cost more than engine cleaning, so a cheaper sorbent opens sites

lab.synth: porous polymer or grafted silica (est.; no early example yet), 2-3 variants: 10-16 wk class
lab.test: lab breakthrough of D4/D5/TMS in humid CH4/CO2 with toluene, GC-MS/FID, 3 regen cycles; university lab (no ASTM method)
lab.logic: synth 12 wk + tests 6 wk; $35k sorbent prep + ~$20k breakthrough/GC work

sale.gates: 3-6 month side-stream pilot on real WWTP/landfill gas; meet engine OEM fuel Si limit and RNG tariff spec
